title: On a phone the field, its arrow and the + work without hover
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} is open and not invoiced; it has one approved labor line and one part, and its one "Sales Representative" field reads {Sales-rep-A}.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Starting screen: {Work-order-1} is open on a phone (a touch screen with no mouse pointer).
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Tap the card's edit button to expand it and look at the Sales Representative field without tapping it.
  2. Tap the Sales Representative field.
  3. Tap "Unassigned".
  4. Tap the + button and tap "Sales Representative - Parts".
  5. Tap the remove x beside "Sales Representative - Parts".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the field already shows its dropdown arrow, and the + button shows beside it at its full size, without any hover.
  • Step 2: the same dropdown Lead Technician and Service Advisor open on a phone opens, with "Unassigned" first and the same options as on a desktop; {Sales-rep-A} is checked. There is no x inside the field.
  • Step 3: the field reads "Unassigned".
  • Step 4: "Sales Representative - Labor" and "Sales Representative - Parts" show, both reading "Unassigned", each with its arrow showing; the remove x shows beside Parts.
  • Step 5: one "Sales Representative" field shows again, reading "Unassigned".

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10890; story SV-11267 (Story 3, Set the representatives on a phone); PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S3-R1, S3-R2, S3-R3, S3-R4, read 19 Oct 2026. Source-verified 19 October 2026. The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R1: “Tapping a Sales Representative field opens the same dropdown Lead Technician and Service Advisor open on a phone, with the same options as on a desktop (S1-R8, S1-R9).”
  • S3-R2: “The + and remove x buttons are always shown, at the same 32px size (S2-R1, S2-R8), and work as on a desktop (Story 2).”
  • S3-R3: “A field is cleared as on a desktop, by picking "Unassigned" (S1-R10). There is no x inside a field.”
  • S3-R4: “Nothing in the fields or the buttons depends on hover. On a touch screen the Sales Representative fields always show their dropdown arrow, as the + and remove x buttons always do. Lead Technician and Service Advisor keep today's behavior, where the arrow shows once the field is tapped.”
